name: Propanidid
summary: Propanidid is an ultra short-acting phenylacetate general anesthetic. It was originally introduced by Bayer in 1963 but anaphylactic reactions caused it to be withdrawn shortly afterwards.

uses.text: Propanidid is an ultra short-acting phenylacetate general anesthetic. It was originally introduced by Bayer in 1963 but anaphylactic reactions caused it to be withdrawn shortly afterwards. Similar to Althesin, Cremophor EL was used as part of the formulation for propanidid.

pharmacology.en: It is thought to act by boosting GABA-A receptors, like many general anaesthetics. It is broken down very quickly by enzymes in the blood, which is why its effects are so brief.
pharmacology.zh: 一般認為它和許多全身麻醉劑一樣，透過增強 GABA-A 受體發揮作用。它會被血液中的酵素迅速分解，因此作用非常短暫。
pharmacology.zhHans: 一般认为它和许多全身麻醉剂一样，通过增强 GABA-A 受体发挥作用。它会被血液中的酵素迅速分解，因此作用非常短暂。

sideEffects.en: Its most serious risk was severe allergic reactions (anaphylaxis), which led to its withdrawal. Other reported effects include low blood pressure, involuntary movements and nausea.
sideEffects.zh: 它最嚴重的風險是嚴重過敏反應（過敏性休克），這也是它下市的原因。其他已知副作用包括血壓偏低、不自主動作和噁心。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它最严重的风险是严重过敏反应（过敏性休克），这也是它下市的原因。其他已知副作用包括血压偏低、不自主动作和恶心。

fact.en: Many of the severe allergic reactions blamed on propanidid were later traced to Cremophor EL, the castor oil based solvent used to dissolve it.
fact.zh: 許多歸咎於 propanidid 的嚴重過敏反應，後來被追溯到用來溶解它的蓖麻油類溶劑 Cremophor EL。
fact.zhHans: 许多归咎于 propanidid 的严重过敏反应，后来被追溯到用来溶解它的蓖麻油类溶剂 Cremophor EL。
